_comment: Maps PL/pgSQL record-field / alias names used inside SECURITY DEFINER RPC bodies (supabase/migrations/**/*.sql) to the table.column key they represent in sql-check-constraints.json. Used by scripts/check-rpc-status-literals.mjs to catch obsolete/invalid status literals written or compared inside RPC function bodies -- the exact bug class found in the 2026-09-21 tournament RPC audit (validate_tournament_schedule, generate_round_robin_draw, generate_groups_to_knockout_draw, generate_single_elimination_draw, swap_tournament_fixture_entries all referenced 'draft'/'ready'/'active'/'accepted', none of which the live CHECK constraints or the guard_tournament_stage_status trigger ever allow). Extend this map whenever a new RPC introduces a new record variable or alias for one of these columns.
